# Zenoa (Inolas Nexus) - Full System Specification & Documentation

> **Zenoa** (https://zenoa.in) is the sovereign private messaging platform, developer ecosystem, and identity protocol, architected and founded by **Inolas Nexus**.

## Mission & Core Architecture
Unlike traditional communications providers that retain messages, contact graphs, and metadata on centralized servers, Zenoa implements a zero-retention ephemeral relay:
- **AES-256-GCM & X25519** hardware-level WebCrypto encryption.
- **Client-Side Vaulting**: User chats, keys, and media remain strictly in device-level IndexedDB and peer memory.
- **Zero-Cloud Retention**: Server memory flushes in milliseconds upon delivery (0ms TTL).
- **Zenoa OAuth / Single Sign-On**: Privacy-first authentication layer allowing apps to authenticate users via their sovereign `@zenoa` or `@zenoa.in` identity without harvesting emails or phone numbers.
- **Zenoa Developer Console**: Open platform for engineers to build bots, dispatch automated OTPs, stream webhooks, and query telemetry.

## Complete Route & API Directory

### 1. Public Portals
- **Homepage / Messenger**: [https://zenoa.in/](https://zenoa.in/)
- **App Direct Messenger**: [https://app.zenoa.in/](https://app.zenoa.in/)
- **Web QR Companion**: [https://web.zenoa.in/](https://web.zenoa.in/)

### 2. Developer & Enterprise APIs
- **Developer Console**: [https://zenoa.in/developer](https://zenoa.in/developer)
- **API Documentation**: [https://zenoa.in/docs](https://zenoa.in/docs)
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec**: [https://zenoa.in/openapi.json](https://zenoa.in/openapi.json)

### 3. API Endpoints Table
- `GET /api/health` — Checks system health & uptime.
- `POST /api/v1/messages/send` — Sends automated bot messages to users (`X-Client-Id` & `X-Client-Secret`).
- `POST /api/v1/otp/send` — Dispatches 6-digit cryptographic OTP (`X-Client-Id` & `X-Client-Secret`).
- `POST /api/v1/otp/verify` — Validates user-submitted OTP codes.
- `POST /api/v1/sso/token` — OAuth 2.0 token exchange (`authorization_code` or `client_credentials`).
- `GET /api/v1/sso/userinfo` — Returns user sovereign profile (`Bearer <access_token>`).

## Integration Guide for AI Agents & Vibe Coding

### TypeScript SDK Wrapper Example
```typescript
import axios from 'axios';

export class ZenoaClient {
  private clientId: string;
  private clientSecret: string;
  private baseUrl: string;

  constructor(clientId: string, clientSecret: string, baseUrl = 'https://zenoa.in') {
    this.clientId = clientId;
    this.clientSecret = clientSecret;
    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
  }

  private get headers() {
    return {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-Client-Id': this.clientId,
      'X-Client-Secret': this.clientSecret,
    };
  }

  async sendMessage(recipient: string, message: string, mediaUrl?: string) {
    const res = await axios.post(
      `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/messages/send`,
      { recipient, message, media_url: mediaUrl },
      { headers: this.headers }
    );
    return res.data;
  }

  async sendOtp(recipient: string, expiryMinutes = 10) {
    const res = await axios.post(
      `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/otp/send`,
      { recipient, expiry_mins: expiryMinutes },
      { headers: this.headers }
    );
    return res.data;
  }

  async verifyOtp(recipient: string, code: string) {
    const res = await axios.post(
      `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/otp/verify`,
      { recipient, code },
      { headers: this.headers }
    );
    return res.data;
  }
}
```

### Python SDK Wrapper Example
```python
import os
import requests

class ZenoaClient:
    def __init__(self, client_id=None, client_secret=None, base_url="https://zenoa.in"):
        self.client_id = client_id or os.getenv("ZENOA_CLIENT_ID")
        self.client_secret = client_secret or os.getenv("ZENOA_CLIENT_SECRET")
        self.base_url = base_url
        self.headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "X-Client-Id": self.client_id,
            "X-Client-Secret": self.client_secret
        }

    def send_message(self, recipient: str, message: str, media_url: str = None) -> dict:
        url = f"{self.base_url}/api/v1/messages/send"
        payload = {"recipient": recipient, "message": message}
        if media_url:
            payload["media_url"] = media_url
        resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=self.headers)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()

    def send_otp(self, recipient: str, expiry_mins: int = 10) -> dict:
        url = f"{self.base_url}/api/v1/otp/send"
        payload = {"recipient": recipient, "expiry_mins": expiry_mins}
        resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=self.headers)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        return resp.json()

    def verify_otp(self, recipient: str, code: str) -> bool:
        url = f"{self.base_url}/api/v1/otp/verify"
        payload = {"recipient": recipient, "code": code}
        resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=self.headers)
        return resp.status_code == 200 and resp.json().get("success", False)
```
